articles.title: Fidelity Collapses with Table Size, Not Turn Count: Delivery Architecture in a Deployed Tool-Using Agent

draft.overview: 评估多轮筛选中让结果表绕过模型、从会话状态直接交付的收益
draft.reason: 订票助手查到了航班，为什么最后给你的清单还会错？研究者让助手挑出下午起飞的航班。清单越长，模型重新列出结果时越容易出错；让模型只说筛选条件，由程序直接交付符合条件的航班，这组实验里 93 次都答对了。

blocks.body:
研究者保存了六条航线的查询结果。每次从同一张表的开头多取一些航班，再问同一个问题。这样就能单独观察清单变长的影响。
让 Gemini 2.5 Flash 自己列出航班时，输入 5 行，83% 的回答拿到满分；输入 100 行，只有 6%。差距在第一次筛选时就出现了。
blocks.evidence: from 83% at K=5 to 6% at K=100 while BYPASS is perfect in all 93 runs

blocks.body:
直接交付清单的方案还做了另一件事：它把原始记录保存在会话里。实验测到的是两项改动加在一起的效果。
下次看助手演示订票或查库存，可以让它处理一张长表，把最终清单和工具查到的记录逐行对一遍。屏幕上的“查询成功”只回答了前半个问题。
blocks.evidence: attributable to the pair, not to either member

localization.reason_en: A flight search finds the right records. How can the assistant still hand you the wrong list? Asked to pick afternoon departures, the model made more mistakes as the list grew. When the model supplied only the filter and a program returned the matching flights, all 93 runs in this experiment earned full credit.
localization.summary_en:
The researchers saved results for six routes. They took progressively more flights from the start of each route’s table and asked the same question each time. That let them isolate the effect of list length.
When Gemini 2.5 Flash listed the flights itself, 83% of answers earned full credit on five rows and only 6% on 100 rows. The gap showed up on the very first filter request.
localization.thinking_en:
The direct-delivery setup also saved the original records across turns. The experiment measured the combined effect of both changes.
Next time you see a booking or inventory demo, try a long list and compare the final answer with the tool’s records, row by row. The “search successful” message tells you only how the first half went.
localization.image_title_en: Figure 2 · Fidelity as tool results grow
localization.image_caption_en: Each table grows by appending rows to a fixed payload. Across six routes, Flash synthesis falls to 6% fidelity at 100 rows. Direct delivery is correct in all 93 runs. Shading shows 95% Wilson intervals.
localization.image_alt_en: The orange synthesis curve drops as rows are added. The blue direct-delivery curve stays at 100%.

original_image.title: 图 2 · 工具结果表变长时，交付准确率如何变化
original_image.caption: 同一份结果按行扩展。六条航线汇总后，Flash 转述组在 100 行时的准确率降至 6%，直接交付组的 93 次运行均正确。阴影为 95% Wilson 区间。
original_image.alt: 随行数增加，橙色模型转述曲线下降，蓝色直接交付曲线保持在 100%。

draft.overview: 为本地 MCP 服务单独配置可写目录和联网权限
draft.reason: 给编程助手装一个记笔记的工具，它能改动电脑上的哪些文件？在 Codex 里，按文中的默认方式接入这个本地工具，它就有了和你一样的文件与联网权限。作者让它照样能记笔记，却只能写两个指定目录，连网也用不着。

blocks.body:
这个记忆工具通过 MCP 接入 Codex，在你的电脑上作为单独的程序运行。文章考察的是一种叫 stdio 的本地连接方式。作者先建好笔记目录，把指定版本的软件包下载到缓存，再把工具放进沙箱，也就是一个限制程序权限的运行环境。
下次启动时，工具从缓存读软件包，把笔记存进数据目录。即使关闭网络、只允许写入缓存和数据目录，它也能启动。
blocks.evidence: without network access, with writes limited to the npm cache and the server’s data directory

blocks.body:
Codex 单凭启动命令，推断不出一个工具为了工作需要哪些文件或网络服务。这些权限要由接入工具的人决定。
看一个工具的安装说明时，可以找两个答案：我的笔记会存在哪里？它还被允许写到哪里？前者告诉你去哪儿找笔记，后者才告诉你一次误操作可能波及什么。
blocks.evidence: Codex cannot reliably infer which files or network services that server needs

localization.reason_en: You give a coding assistant a note-taking tool. Which files on your computer can it change? In the local setup shown for Codex, the tool starts with your own file and network permissions. The author shows that it can still keep notes with writes limited to two directories and networking switched off.
localization.summary_en:
The memory tool connects to Codex through MCP and runs as a separate program on your computer. The example uses a local connection called stdio. The author creates a notes directory, caches a specific version of the software package, and launches the tool in a sandbox that limits its permissions.
At startup the tool reads the package from the cache. It can start offline, with writes allowed only to the cache and its data directory.
localization.thinking_en:
Codex cannot tell from a launch command which files or network services a tool needs. The person connecting the tool has to make that decision.
When reading an installation guide, look for two answers: where will my notes be saved, and where else is the tool allowed to write? The first helps you find your notes. The second tells you what an accidental change could affect.
localization.image_title_en: How Codex applies a permission profile to a command
localization.image_caption_en: Codex launches the command under the session’s permission profile. Child processes inherit the sandbox restrictions. When enabled, the network proxy enforces domain rules.
localization.image_alt_en: Flow diagram showing how configuration and managed requirements define the session’s permission profile. Codex uses the profile to launch a command in a sandbox on macOS, Linux, or Windows. Child processes inherit the restrictions, and an optional network proxy filters requests by domain.

original_image.title: Codex 如何把权限配置应用到命令
original_image.caption: Codex 按会话权限配置启动命令，子进程继承沙箱限制。启用网络代理时，由代理执行域名规则。
original_image.alt: 流程图中，配置和管理员设定的约束共同确定会话权限配置。Codex 据此在 macOS、Linux 或 Windows 的沙箱中启动命令。子进程继承限制，可选的网络代理按域名规则筛选请求。

articles.title: Building Evidence-Grounded Agent Memory with OpenWiki and Graphs

draft.overview: 评估跨文档问答何时值得编译维基并接入证据图
draft.reason: 假设一份保单有了补充条款，原来的约定还算数吗？搜到旧条款很容易，弄清哪一条改了哪一条才难。在模拟保险文档上，事先把条款关系整理成一本可查的手册，助手更会回答这类问题；只查一段原文时，直接搜索反而更快，得分也相近。

blocks.body:
研究者用 111 份模拟文档编了两类题：80 道只需找到一段话，50 道要把不同文件里的线索连起来。同一个助手做跨文档题，直接搜索得 0.10 分，有了手册得 0.52 分，满分为 1。
再把手册里的说法逐条连回原文段落，得分升到 0.66。同一道题问三遍，答案引用相同证据的程度也翻了一倍。

这项测试把“答得对”和“三次回答引用了相同段落”分开计分。一个助手完全可能每次都引用同一条旧规定，给出同一个错答。
下次让助手解释一份改过的合同，可以请它同时找出原条款和修改它的那段文字。两段放在一起，你才有材料自己判断哪一条适用。
blocks.evidence: whether the agent reliably grounds its answers in the same sources

localization.reason_en: Suppose a policy has an amendment. Does the original promise still hold? Finding the old clause is easy; working out what changed is harder. On simulated insurance documents, an assistant answered these questions better with a guide to how clauses connect. For a single-passage lookup, plain search was faster and scored about as well.
localization.summary_en:
The researchers used 111 simulated documents to build 80 single-passage questions and 50 that required connecting different files. On the cross-document questions, the same assistant scored 0.10 out of 1 with search and 0.52 with a compiled guide.
Linking individual claims in the guide back to source paragraphs raised the score to 0.66. When the researchers asked each question three times, overlap between the passages cited also doubled.
localization.thinking_en:
The study scored correctness separately from citing the same passages across three answers. An assistant could consistently cite an outdated rule and consistently get the answer wrong.
Next time an assistant explains an amended contract, ask it to find both the original clause and the passage that changed it. Seeing them side by side gives you a way to judge which one applies.
localization.image_title_en: Three memory setups on cross-document questions
localization.image_caption_en: Moving from the wiki alone to a wiki with an evidence graph raised accuracy from 0.52 to 0.66 and cut median answer time from 30 to 18 seconds in the authors’ evaluation.
localization.image_alt_en: Four charts compare accuracy, citation consistency, cost per correct answer, and median latency with search alone, a wiki, or a wiki plus an evidence graph.

original_image.title: 三种记忆方案怎样回答跨文档查询
original_image.caption: 作者比较了三种方案。从单用 wiki 到加入证据图，正确率从 0.52 升到 0.66，中位回答时间从 30 秒降到 18 秒。
original_image.alt: 原文四幅柱状图比较仅搜索、只用 wiki 及 wiki 加证据图的正确率、引用一致性、每个正确回答的成本和中位回答时间。
